caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a pedestal glass bowl or goblet, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The bowl is rendered in varying shades of purple, indicating transparency and light reflection typical of glass material. The upper part of the bowl is cylindrical with a smooth rim, while the body below features a diamond-pattern cut design, suggesting a faceted glass surface. The bowl sits on a short, thick stem that flares outwards at the base to form a stable, circular foot. The overall composition is simple, with the object fully contained within a lightly outlined rectangular border, and the artist’s name, "JOHN DANA," is written in small print in the lower right corner inside the border. There are no other objects, patterns, or colors present apart from the purple glass bowl and the neutral-toned background.
title: Sugar Bowl
